01 / THE PROJECT

More than a car.
A reason to get our
hands dirty.

We’re a youth-led team bringing a 1968 Chevrolet Corvair back to life. Along the way, we’re learning from the people who know these cars best—and sharing everything we discover.

Meet Legacy Garage 26 ↗
02 / THE RESTORATION ROADMAP

A long road.
A good reason to start.

We’re documenting the journey from the car’s starting condition to the goal of getting it back on the road. Here’s the plan.

01—02

Meet the machine.

Document the starting condition. Inspect, listen, and make a plan.

03—04

Into the details.

Disassemble thoughtfully. Understand what needs work.

05—06

Bring it together.

Body, interior, and the careful work of reassembly.

07—08

Back to the road.

Check the work. Learn from the results. Keep the story going.

Explore all eight milestones ↗
